Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: In Step 4, the Planner incorrectly analyzed the text from the Wikipedia page. The visible text on the page clearly states: "The son of Rupert III of the Palatinate". However, the Planner's analysis claimed the text said "the son of Rupert, King of Germany" and further concluded the father was "Rupert II, Elector Palatine". This is a hallucination; the text explicitly reads "Rupert III", not "Rupert II" or "Rupert, King of Germany". The Planner failed to read the source text accurately and invented a different name and title for the father.
